verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists a built-in "Conversational meeting assistant" alongside AI-generated summaries and action items, so there is first-party evidence of an in-product AI assistant. Nothing documents what tasks a user can hand to it. The MCP server only exposes meeting data to external assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude, so it is not credited as a built-in assistant. missing for 10: documentation of what the in-product assistant can do, evidence of task delegation or agentic actions beyond Q&A/summaries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
